behavior.futureDate: Static branch renders a localized releases-on label instead of the year.

substitutions: JSX records inert element trees; typography and tooltip are labels.
The standard date parser is replaced with JavaScript Date for the supplied valid ISO inputs.
Tooltip/precision formatting and future-release localization are inert and are not verified by the executed cases.
scope: Original shipped song-page data flow and metadata order inspected statically. The original release-date renderer independently executed for past dates and missing metadata. No network, playback, or Flutter implementation is exercised.
limitations: No claim about other Spotify versions, experiments, track-list columns, tooltip formatting, or live server metadata for Flying Bird.

flutterPort.source: The album.date already supplied by the decoded native TrackV4 response.
flutterPort.projection: A present positive year produces release.isoString at UTC midnight with the supplied month/day and DAY, MONTH or YEAR precision. Missing month/day use the first month/day only to represent that declared precision. Missing/zero year produces no release field.
flutterPort.consumer: The existing lib/entities/view.dart song header reads release.isoString and places its year after the album name.
flutterPort.traffic: No additional request, decode, cache, polling or playback action.
flutterPort.scope: Ports the album release year into existing song metadata. Other song-header fields and future-release/tooltip formatting are outside this change.

verification.method: Executed the production _nativeTrackRow method in an isolated macOS Flutter debug process with synthetic decoded TrackV4 metadata, then supplied that unmodified row to the production EntityView.
verification.analyzer: No diagnostic on the changed lines. The runtime/view analysis reports 22 existing warnings and style notices.
verification.limitations: The probe has no account/session, playback engine or network sender. This proves metadata projection and the visible full-date header, not live server metadata for a particular song. The installed release was not rebuilt.
